analogy.rationale: Dopamine reuptake inhibitors block SLC6A3 (DAT), which is barely expressed in these cell lines, so the transcriptional response should be weak; the closest analogs are other monoamine transporter/reuptake inhibitors that share the same transporter-blocking pharmacology and similarly low expression of their targets.
